notes: A GPU that crashes on startup is now told apart from one that is merely slow. A container that starts, dies and starts again reports as 'initializing' on most health polls, which is exactly what a first boot downloading its model looks like — so the app kept granting it more time and waited out the entire budget for a worker that was never going to serve. RunPod does report the difference on the polls that land between restarts, and two sightings is now the verdict: the job is cancelled within about half a minute and the error names the cause instead of blaming a slow cold start. Test vision endpoint checks the same thing rather than sitting for 90 seconds and calling it a normal first boot. The usual culprit is a pinned model revision that no longer exists on Hugging Face — RunPod stamps that commit when the endpoint is created and it goes stale — so the message points at the endpoint's Logs tab and at clearing MODEL_REVISION.
